name: Enthalpy v0.4.17
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.17

## Added

- Automations can create a new dated note in a selected folder. Choose the
  filename, title, note type, and Markdown format, including blank sections
  for meeting notes. Existing files stay protected.

## Fixed

- Automation reviews, unfinished descriptions, and unsaved edits remain
  available when you switch tabs and return.
- Managed Automation result notes use the Automation name in their title.

## Preview limits

- Hosted Sync remains available only to the approved owner account on macOS
  Apple Silicon. Windows Sync enrollment is deferred until its installed-build
  acceptance passes.
- Use only disposable test data until the independent protocol and cryptographic
  review is complete.
- Account creation stays invite-only with a hard one-account limit.
- Linux packages are deferred.
